note.zh-TW: 同一張名詞卡也用於直接法版面的營業活動標題。
note.en: The same card serves the operating activities heading of the direct-method layout.

definition.zh-TW: 本業收錢與付錢所產生的現金流量，例如收到貨款、付貨款、付薪資與稅金。模板三大活動的第一段，教材用間接法從稅前淨利調整出來。
definition.en: Cash flows from the main business: collecting from customers, paying suppliers, wages and taxes. The first of the three activity sections in the template; the course derives it by the indirect method from profit before tax.
